title: ALICompat Supported Mods Schema
description: Minecraft-version-agnostic registry of every mod ALICompat provides support for (supported_mods.json). check_versions.py and modpack.py read it as their source of truth; gradle.properties holds only what the current branch resolves from it.

key.description: Identifier of the shim within this repository: the '<key>_<loader>_dep' property prefix, the 'compat_mods' entry, the 'src/compat/<key>' source set and the 'com.yanny.alicompat.compat.<key>' package.

name.description: Human readable mod name, used in the generated gradle.properties comments and in reports.

mod_ids.description: Runtime mod ids the shim gates on. More than one when a single CurseForge project ships several mod ids (Porting Lib).

curseforge.description: CurseForge projects for this mod, as '<slug>-<project id>' (the artifact half of the 'curse.maven' coordinate). Usually one; a second entry is for mods published as a separate project per loader. Which project serves which loader is derived from CurseForge per Minecraft version, not declared here.

items.description: '<slug>-<project id>', e.g. 'the-bumblezone-forge-362479'. The slug is the last segment of the project URL. No file id: the pinned file is Minecraft-version specific and lives in gradle.properties.
